name: Gadrin's Blessing holds in Echo Isles while an Echo Isles quest is taken (#4628)
contract: Gadrin's Blessing 675910 (+100% swim speed) is cast on a player standing in Echo Isles (area 368) who has Minshina's Skull 808, Practical Prey 817, A Solvent Spirit 818 or Zalazane 826 in the log, incomplete or complete, and is removed once that quest is rewarded. The players stand at Zalazane's spawn (creature guid 13001), which the server map grid 0013442 places in area 368.
